title: 5 Mistakes That RUIN Your First 30 Days at a New Job
description:
Your first 30 days at a new job can make or break your career trajectory. In this video, I'm breaking down the 5 biggest mistakes people make in their first month at work—and how to avoid them so you can set yourself up for success from day one.

Whether you're starting a new job next week or just want to be prepared for your next career move, these tips will help you navigate your first 30 days with confidence and professionalism.

 WHAT YOU'LL LEARN:
 The #1 mistake that makes you look unprofessional in your first month
 Why trying to prove yourself too quickly can backfire
 How to build relationships without being too pushy
 The balance between asking questions and appearing incompetent
 What NOT to do in your first 30 days at work
